card.headline: Automate only where it is safe.
card.body: Find the manual work eating budget and morale. Never hand it off on blind trust.

alt: Dark card reading: Automate only where it is safe. Step three of the TRACE method.
linkedin:
Automation is step three, not step one.

In the TRACE method, A for Automation comes after the targets are set and the roadmap is built. That order matters.

We find the manual work quietly eating your budget and your team's morale, then hand it off. Only where it is safe. Never on blind trust.

Automating a broken process just breaks it faster.

Target, Roadmap, Automation, Cadence, Enterprise. See the full method at tracestrategies.com.
